items.title: Copper’s record run is sending three clear messages about the state of financial markets today
items.content: Copper just hit a fresh record, while one ETF tracking the metal is up nearly 20% in August and on pace for its best month on record.

items.title: Is Nvidia heading for $1 trillion in annual revenue? One analyst now thinks that’s possible.
items.content: Nvidia’s stock is moving higher after earnings.

items.title: Salesforce sparks a software-stock rally — and pushes back on AI doomsday fears
items.content: Salesforce’s earnings showed that AI isn’t killing traditional software, and that the operators of major AI models are willing to strike partnerships with legacy vendors.

items.title: Why these analysts say bitcoin will double by next year — and could reach $500,000 by the end of the decade
items.content: Bitcoin has had a revival lately. Bernstein analysts think the cryptocurrency is headed for a new high of $300,000 by 2029.

items.title: Buying 30-year bonds? Locking in today’s rates could hurt your retirement planning.
items.content: Right now the bond market is acting in a way it hasn’t in two decades, and a lot of people are going to be caught off guard by what that means for the “safe” part of their money.

items.title: CrowdStrike’s stock has jumped after record-breaking earnings. Wall Street is lapping it up.
items.content: A number of Wall Street banks, including Jefferies, raised their price targets for the cybersecurity’s stock following its record-breaking results.

items.title: Am I too old for Roth conversions? I’m 84 and my wife is 77. We have $8 million saved.

items.title: Here’s how the private-listing war between Zillow and Compass could cost home buyers and sellers
items.content: Real-estate giants Compass and Zillow are battling over control of home listings. Consumer advocates and industry experts warn that buyers and sellers could pay a price.
